display_name: LoRa 实收噪声方差与私有复谱修正风险
description: Source-U comparison of incremental private-spectrum waveform risk estimated from received IQ against isolated physical references.
authorization: User handoff from 01a1dedc-e242-78a2-8064-20079b2070eb and active LoRa/WiSig observable recovery goal. Source screen only.

data.representation: Aligned six chirps at 256 kHz. Fixed private-spectrum edits under received-coordinate RMS; two generic and two registered views per route.
data.physical_ids_ref: Source U metadata, fixed prior split and first 30 per source RX from held role. No source V or target metadata.

permissions.claim_scope: Waveform diagnosis on held source U only. No recognition or target statistics.

checkpoint.initialization: Unmodified frozen rank-four restoration and inherited bypass.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Inherited source-only clean-U generic-perturbation rank-four lineage and existing bypass. Candidate reads no exact reference; no F, TX, V or target.
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed local risk rule. No source fitting. Keep for later recognition ablation only if preregistered physical checks pass.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU-only. Six ordinary CPU workers for replay, no GPU allocation.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on contract, numeric or exact source replay mismatch, or incomplete smoke/diagnostic artifact.

metric_names: per-band MSE relative to the Wiener midpoint
risk sign agreement and Pearson correlation
private real gain and phase error
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: private_band_risk_source.py, independent reference path within source waveform diagnosis

rows.method: Received-only noise-adjusted risk and matched fixed doses
rows.purpose: Source-U-only waveform risk and direction falsification
rows.seed_notes: Fixed held U split, fixed generic IQ perturbations and Rademacher probe draws. Frozen restoration weights.
rows.scenario: clean, generic white/colored, Full/Residual low suburban and low urban
rows.budget_ref: 150 held source U packets. Four central difference probes per active packet.

notes: No classifier or TX identity labels, source V or target reads.
Prior registered routes supply received IQ and a separately isolated comparison only. No exact noise input, calibration or training.
